name: Velora
description: Velora, formerly ParaSwap, is a DEX aggregator and intent-based trading protocol. It routes swaps across many liquidity sources on Ethereum and major EVM networks, and its Delta mode lets users sign orders that agents execute on their behalf.
description_zh: Velora（原 ParaSwap）是一个 DEX 聚合器和基于意图的交易协议。它在以太坊和主要 EVM 网络上的众多流动性来源之间路由兑换，其 Delta 模式允许用户签署订单，由代理代为执行。

geo_site.method: The price API the app quotes with (api.velora.xyz/prices) answers an empty HTTP 403 to some countries, so no swap can be quoted there; the landing page itself is served. The countries are those of the live probe (see the observations; 2026-10-12: BY, CU, IQ, IR, LY, MM, RU, SD, SY, ZW).

tos.restricted: CU, IR, MM, KP, CN, SY, Crimea, DPR, LPR + sanctioned

notes: Closed. The Velora API is public. Closed frontend; the geo-block sits in the price API (api.velora.xyz), not on the page: without JavaScript the site looks open everywhere.

api_probes.name: price route
api_probes.note: The price route the app requests for a swap (ETH -> USDC on Ethereum); the API answers an empty HTTP 403 to some countries.

rules.note: the price API refuses the country (empty HTTP 403): the app cannot quote a swap
